pitfalls: The redistributable vendored source omits the forcing/restart archive used by this official example.

pitfalls.symptom: Plain make applies an implicit Modula-2 rule to Fortran .mod targets and invokes unavailable m2c.
pitfalls.workaround: Build with make -r to disable built-in implicit rules.

pitfalls.symptom: The wrapper can return exit status zero even when a later make invocation fails.
pitfalls.workaround: Invoke make -r directly and verify that the expected executable was produced.

pitfalls.symptom: nf-config --flibs alone did not resolve all NetCDF-C symbols on the investigation host.
Three common-container tests do not compile with gfortran 16.x because of assumed-length character allocation.
pitfalls.workaround: Record them as upstream toolchain incompatibilities; do not patch the pinned source during investigation.

not_run.why: Their maps, forcing, restart, and optional levee/reservoir/sediment inputs are not present at the scripts' default paths in the vendored payload.
Compilation is blocked by the gfortran 16.x array_mod incompatibility.
